title: Machinery map (derived)
description: A DERIVED render artifact (NOT a canonical store object): the AST-grounded machinery map emitted by render/derive_machinery.py from machinery_overlay.json + the real code. Lives at research_os/render/machinery_map.json, gitignored. The web backend only READS it (indexer.load_machinery_map). Staleness is keyed on the CODE: `code_fingerprint` records a content sha per scanned file; the indexer recomputes it and flags the map stale once the machinery source moves. `drift` is the computed overlay-vs-code cross-check.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp the map was derived.

generated_for_code.description: sha over the code_fingerprint; the indexer marks the map stale when it no longer matches the live code.

code_fingerprint.description: Repo-relative path → content sha (12 hex) of every scanned file; the staleness witness.

stale.description: Added by the indexer at read time (not by the derive): true when the live code no longer matches code_fingerprint.

exists.description: False when the curated unit was not found in the code (a `drift.missing` entry).

calls.description: Other node names this function invokes (the data-flow edges).

missing.description: Curated units no longer found in the code.

uncovered.description: Public module-level/method defs in scope_files that no unit covers yet.
